note: Numbers for the Skirmish / Distraction engagement. Everything here is a first guess for playtesting.
modeNote: "stance" = the stance duel (v0.4). "classic" = the older Engage with Press / Break away.
beatOddsNote: With these numbers: same stance, a class strong in it beats one weak in it about 79% of the time; equal fighters where one stance beats the other, 64%; a strong class that picked the beaten stance, 55%.
rangedBreakNote: An archer caught in a clash cannot shoot, so on its turn it tries to Break away this often (in %), unless it is winning the clash.

signatures.note: Signature stances (Suleiman's tank design). A unit has one if its job in jobs.json has a signature line. Its defence works while it is in a clash and its last stance is the signature stance.

bloodied.note: Bloodied Press (Warlord, Berserker): every hit taken adds a stack. In Press, each stack takes 1 off every hit. Winning a beat with Press lands a quick hit of winHitBase + stacks, and a decisive win pushes 1 tile further.

counter.note: Counter-Press (Bruiser): in Press, the gauntlet soaks up to absorb damage of the first hit after each beat. Every chargePer damage soaked is 1 Charge. Losing a beat releases all Charge as a counter-punch of damagePerCharge per Charge.

bulwark.note: Bulwark (Warden): each beat in a row held in Guard adds a level. Each level pushes him 1 tile less. An even beat in Guard gives back standoffPoise Poise and standoffHeal health.

stanceChoiceNote: How heroes pick stances in a clash, until the player switches: "auto" (one Fight button picks for you) or "manual" (Press, Guard and Slip buttons). The player's switch is remembered on their device.
